title: Sahaay AI Phase A: Live Map & Road Network Foundation Report
summary: Phase A successfully establishes the canonical geospatial road network data model, GeoJSON feature collection endpoints, OpenStreetMap ingestion and normalization pipeline, and Leaflet map visualization for Greater Hyderabad corridors without conflating unknown status with safe passage.
